item.description: Meets in L5 breakout to share what people are reading. All welcome — bring your lunch or a coffee.

item.description: The Executive meets for their fortnightly catch up this Thursday.

item.description: Congratulations to everyone involved in the successful launch of the Workday Finance Management System — a key Elevate milestone. See the News Hub post.

item.description: Free, confidential support for you and your family: counselling, wellbeing, financial coaching and nutrition. Watch the recording or visit the People Hub.

item.description: Lunchtime Pilates returns as a four-week series — a good way to keep moving as winter settles in.

item.description: Thanks to every participant for your enthusiasm, teamwork and commitment. Keep those steps going and make wellness part of every day.

item.description: Booked a Ground Floor room and need setup help? Email Reception and Nathan Crick 24–48 hours ahead, and allow 30 minutes before your meeting.

item.title: Farewells – Pawan Ahuja & Tommy Ling (10 July)
item.description: Pawan Ahuja (Service Investigations) and Tommy Ling (Full Stack Developer) finish up on 10 July. Thank you both and all the best for the future.

item.title: Wellness Corner – Overcoming Your Fears
item.description: Fears hold us back. Acknowledge them and take steps to overcome them — like beating a fear of public speaking to open new doors.
